items.headline: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon model
items.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Neon, bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across software engineering, knowledge work and science workflows. It follows the Gemini 4 Carbon release earlier in the month.

items.headline: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon from Google DeepMind
items.summary: Google began rolling out Gemini 4 Neon, bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across software engineering, knowledge work and science. It joins the expanding Gemini 4 family of frontier models.

items.headline: Google begins rolling out Gemini 4 Neon frontier model
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Neon started rolling out with frontier-level intelligence and fast end-to-end task completion across software engineering, knowledge work and science. It is available to developers, enterprises, consumers and cybersecurity defenders.

items.headline: xAI releases Grok 4.7 frontier model on API
items.summary: xAI's Grok 4.7 is now available via the xAI API with a 500k context window, text and image inputs, and tiered pricing from $2 per 1M input tokens. It supports reasoning effort levels up to xhigh for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work.

items.headline: Anthropic details Fable 5.2 circuit board design gains
items.summary: Anthropic demonstrated that Claude Fable 5.2 scored 69% on an internal PCB Gym benchmark versus 25% for Fable 5, and 83.5% on the public BenchCAD 2.1 test. The results show sharp improvements in AI capabilities for electronics and hardware engineering tasks.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model
items.summary: Google made its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, available to developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers. It touts higher-precision knowledge work, improved agentic coding and state-of-the-art cybersecurity capabilities.

items.headline: Anthropic upgrades Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic released upgraded Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models with improvements in coding, reasoning and vision. In testing they completed complex software migrations, designed electronic devices and formalized a proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in 30 hours.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon now available from Google DeepMind
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model offering higher-precision knowledge work, improved agentic coding and state-of-the-art cybersecurity capabilities. It is available to developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
items.summary: Anthropic launched two new frontier models, its first since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow the pace of AI development in September. The company said the models underwent rigorous safety testing and that it 'called for pacing, not pausing.'

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic launched two new frontier models, its first since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow AI development in September. The company said the models underwent rigorous safety testing, framing the release as 'pacing, not pausing.'
